newsitem.title: CHINA: China Sept trade surplus $3.2 billion - customs.
newsitem.headline: China Sept trade surplus $3.2 billion - customs.

text.p: China's trade surplus was $3.2 billion in September, according to customs figures released by state television.
(Note: figures given in billions of U.S. dollars)
China had a trade surplus of $3.0 billion in August, customs figures showed.
The surplus for the first eight months was $4.99 billion, down from $15.27 billion in the year-ago period.
Customs did not give a figure for the first nine months.
State radio said September exports slipped by five percent compared with August, while imports fell by 7.6 percent.
